text:
Lake Wind Advisory is up, so if you're heading onto Lake Champlain this afternoon, expect the breeze to build. Burlington is only at 61 under partial sun so far, with a steady north wind around 15 mph, and the afternoon should stay cool rather than warm, topping out somewhere from the upper 60s to around 71. On the broad lake, north winds increase to 15 to 25 knots with waves building to 1 to 2 feet, so this is not a leisurely small-boat window.

Away from the water, the rest of Saturday looks mainly dry, with clouds thickening tonight and a 30% chance of showers after 2am. Sunday is cooler, mostly cloudy, and breezy, with a high near 66 and a better chance of passing showers. Enjoy the dry daylight hours, but get off the lake before the stronger afternoon wind arrives and keep a rain jacket handy for Sunday.
